title: Harvard Business School — Eric joins both sections of Launching Tech Ventures for a session on governance and mission protection
summary: Eric was a guest in Harvard Business School's Launching Tech Ventures, the MBA course taught by Jeff Bussgang and Allison Mnookin, appearing in both sections on Monday 16 November. The session set the book's argument about protecting a mission against the governance structure Anthropic adopted, and what a founder should commit to before raising capital.
